1994. Postfix Expression Evaluator

60

Medium

Problem Statement

Given a postfix expression made up of single-digit operands and the operators +, -, *, /, evaluate its value using a stack.

Description

Read a postfix expression as a line of space-separated tokens, where each token is either a single digit (0-9) or one of the operators +, -, *, /. Push operands onto a stack; whenever an operator is read, pop the top two operands, apply the operator, and push the result back onto the stack.
input_spec: A single line containing a postfix expression with tokens separated by single spaces.
output_spec: Print the integer result of evaluating the postfix expression.
